verses.text: Why do the nations rage and the peoples plot in vain?

xrefs.text: You spoke by the Holy Spirit through the mouth of Your servant, our father David: ‘Why do the nations rage and the peoples plot in vain?
They will make war against the Lamb, and the Lamb will triumph over them, because He is Lord of lords and King of kings; and He will be accompanied by His called and chosen and faithful ones.
Nations rage, kingdoms crumble; the earth melts when He lifts His voice.
Though they intend You harm, the schemes they devise will not prevail.
saying, “Come, let us erase them as a nation; may the name of Israel be remembered no more.”

verses.text: The kings of the earth take their stand and the rulers gather together, against the LORD and against His Anointed One:

xrefs.text: Now the chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin were seeking false testimony against Jesus in order to put Him to death.
The ten horns you saw are ten kings who have not yet received a kingdom, but will receive one hour of authority as kings along with the beast.
When morning came, all the chief priests and elders of the people conspired against Jesus to put Him to death.
You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore God, your God, has anointed you above your companions with the oil of joy.
And even Herod and his soldiers ridiculed and mocked Him. Dressing Him in a fine robe, they sent Him back to Pilate.

verses.text: “Let us break Their chains and cast away Their cords.”

xrefs.text: I will go to the powerful and speak to them. Surely they know the way of the LORD, the justice of their God.” But they too, with one accord, had broken the yoke and torn off the chains.
But his subjects hated him and sent a delegation after him to say, ‘We do not want this man to rule over us.
To you who believe, then, this stone is precious. But to those who do not believe, “The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone,”
And these enemies of mine who were unwilling for me to rule over them, bring them here and slay them in front of me.

verses.text: The One enthroned in heaven laughs; the Lord taunts them.

xrefs.text: but the Lord laughs, seeing that their day is coming.
But You, O LORD, laugh at them; You scoff at all the nations.
in turn I will mock your calamity; I will sneer when terror strikes you,
He sits enthroned above the circle of the earth; its dwellers are like grasshoppers. He stretches out the heavens like a curtain, and spreads them out like a tent to dwell in.
The LORD is in His holy temple; the LORD is on His heavenly throne. His eyes are watching closely; they examine the sons of men.

verses.text: Then He rebukes them in His anger, and terrifies them in His fury:

xrefs.text: but with righteousness He will judge the poor, and with equity He will decide for the lowly of the earth. He will strike the earth with the rod of His mouth and slay the wicked with the breath of His lips.
And from His mouth proceeds a sharp sword with which to strike down the nations, and He will rule them with an iron scepter. He treads the winepress of the fury of the wrath of God the Almighty.
The Lord is at Your right hand; He will crush kings in the day of His wrath.
You will place them in a fiery furnace at the time of Your appearing. In His wrath the LORD will engulf them, and the fire will consume them.
He unleashed His fury against them, wrath, indignation, and calamity— a band of destroying angels.

verses.text: “I have installed My King on Zion, upon My holy mountain.”

xrefs.text: Then I looked and saw the Lamb standing on Mount Zion, and with Him 144,000 who had His name and His Father’s name written on their foreheads.
Then Jesus came to them and said, “All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to Me.
And God put everything under His feet and made Him head over everything for the church,
For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given, and the government will be upon His shoulders. And He will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.
Your throne, O God, endures forever and ever, and justice is the scepter of Your kingdom.

verses.text: I will proclaim the decree spoken to Me by the LORD: “You are My Son; today I have become Your Father.

xrefs.text: So also Christ did not take upon Himself the glory of becoming a high priest, but He was called by the One who said to Him: “You are My Son; today I have become Your Father.”
He has fulfilled for us, their children, by raising up Jesus. As it is written in the second Psalm: ‘You are My Son; today I have become Your Father.’
For to which of the angels did God ever say: “You are My Son; today I have become Your Father” Or again: “I will be His Father, and He will be My Son”
And a voice from heaven said, “This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased!
While Peter was still speaking, a bright cloud enveloped them, and a voice from the cloud said, “This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to Him!

verses.text: Ask Me, and I will make the nations Your inheritance, the ends of the earth Your possession.

xrefs.text: All the ends of the earth will remember and turn to the LORD. All the families of the nations will bow down before Him.
I will indeed appoint him as My firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.
May he rule from sea to sea, and from the Euphrates to the ends of the earth.
I have glorified You on earth by accomplishing the work You gave Me to do.
In my vision in the night I continued to watch, and I saw One like the Son of Man coming with the clouds of heaven. He approached the Ancient of Days and was led into His presence.

verses.text: You will break them with an iron scepter; You will shatter them like pottery.

xrefs.text: And to the one who overcomes and continues in My work until the end, I will give authority over the nations.
And she gave birth to a son, a male child, who will rule all the nations with an iron scepter. And her child was caught up to God and to His throne.
And from His mouth proceeds a sharp sword with which to strike down the nations, and He will rule them with an iron scepter. He treads the winepress of the fury of the wrath of God the Almighty.
I will crush his foes before him and strike down those who hate him.

It will break in pieces like a potter’s jar, shattered so that no fragment can be found. Not a shard will be found in the dust large enough to scoop the coals from a hearth or to skim the water from a cistern.”

verses.text: Therefore be wise, O kings; be admonished, O judges of the earth.

xrefs.text: Whoever is wise, let him understand these things; whoever is discerning, let him know them. For the ways of the LORD are right, and the righteous walk in them but the rebellious stumble in them.
Foreigners will rebuild your walls, and their kings will serve you. Although I struck you in anger, yet in favor I will show you mercy.
so He will sprinkle many nations. Kings will shut their mouths because of Him. For they will see what they have not been told, and they will understand what they have not heard.
May the kings of Tarshish and distant shores bring tribute; may the kings of Sheba and Seba offer gifts.
Nations will come to your light, and kings to the brightness of your dawn.

verses.text: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.

xrefs.text: Therefore, my beloved, just as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now even more in my absence, continue to work out your salvation with fear and trembling.

See to it that you do not refuse Him who speaks. For if the people did not escape when they refused Him who warned them on earth, how much less will we escape if we reject Him who warns us from heaven?
Therefore, since we are receiving an unshakable kingdom, let us be filled with gratitude, and so worship God acceptably with reverence and awe.
In the council of the holy ones, God is greatly feared, and awesome above all who surround Him.
Therefore, while the promise of entering His rest still stands, let us be careful that none of you be deemed to have fallen short of it.

verses.text: Kiss the Son, lest He be angry and you perish in your rebellion, when His wrath ignites in an instant. Blessed are all who take refuge in Him.

xrefs.text: Blessed is the man who has made the LORD his trust, who has not turned to the proud, nor to those who lapse into falsehood.
so that all may honor the Son just as they honor the Father. Whoever does not honor the Son does not honor the Father who sent Him.
Taste and see that the LORD is good; blessed is the man who takes refuge in Him!
O LORD of Hosts, how blessed is the man who trusts in You!
Whoever heeds instruction will find success, and blessed is he who trusts in the LORD.
